dentistry.title: Dentistry Abroad (BDS / DDS / DMD)
dentistry.overview: Premier dental schools in the USA offering cutting-edge clinical infrastructure, ADA accreditation, and global practice scope.
dentistry.eligibility: 10+2 with PCB (minimum 60%) + DAT (Dental Admission Test) / NEET qualification.

nursing.title: Nursing Abroad (BSN / MSN)
nursing.overview: High-demand nursing careers with global clinical rotations, NCLEX-RN preparation, and direct healthcare placement support in top US hospitals.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy Abroad (Pharm.D / B.Pharm)
pharmacy.overview: Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D) degrees accredited by ACPE with comprehensive clinical rotations, pharmacotherapy research, and licensing preparation.

physiotherapy.title: Physiotherapy Abroad (DPT / BPT)
physiotherapy.overview: Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) programs offering advanced rehabilitation sciences, biomechanics, and global clinical residencies.

public_health.title: Public Health Abroad (MPH / DrPH)
public_health.overview: Master of Public Health (MPH) programs specializing in epidemiology, health policy, and global healthcare management with CEPH accreditation.

biotechnology.title: Biotechnology Abroad (B.S. / M.S.)
biotechnology.overview: STEM-designated biotechnology programs combining genetics, bioinformatics, pharmaceutical development, and 3-year OPT work visa benefits.
